modules.name: Todo
modules.description: Keep a task list, check off finished items and undo the last completion.
modules.author: Re:TUI
modules.preview:
1. Buy milk
2. Read a chapter

Done 1   Done 2   Undo last
modules.details: Add one task per line in Configure. Tap Done to complete a task, or Undo last to restore the most recently completed task. Your list stays saved between sessions.
modules.requirements: Re:TUI widget API 1. No additional permissions or apps.

modules.name: Daily Habits
modules.description: Track daily habits with a checklist that starts fresh each day.
modules.author: Re:TUI
modules.preview:
[x] Read
[ ] Stretch
[ ] Walk

Done Stretch   Done Walk
modules.details: Choose your habits in Configure. Tap Done or Undo to change today’s checklist. It resets when you next open or refresh the module on a new local day. Habit history and streaks are not recorded.
modules.requirements: Re:TUI widget API 1. Uses the local phone date; no additional permissions.

modules.name: Focus Timer
modules.description: Start a 5–60 minute focus session and see the time remaining.
modules.author: Re:TUI
modules.details: Set your session length in Configure, then use Start and Stop. The saved deadline survives closing the module. The countdown refreshes while visible; there is no background alarm.
modules.requirements: Re:TUI widget API 1. Approve active ticking. Progress refreshes while visible; no background alarm.

modules.name: Bookmarks
modules.description: Keep named HTTPS links together and open them in your browser.
modules.author: Re:TUI
modules.details: Add one link per line in Configure using Name | https://address. Tap a link’s suggestion to open your browser. Invalid links are flagged. Page titles and thumbnails are not fetched.
modules.requirements: Re:TUI widget API 1. Approve intents to open HTTPS links. Requires an installed browser.

modules.name: Year Progress
modules.description: See how much of the day, week, month and year has passed.
modules.author: Re:TUI
modules.details: Four progress bars use your phone’s local date and time, with Monday as the start of the week and leap years included. The display refreshes while visible. No configuration or network access is needed.
modules.requirements: Re:TUI widget API 1. Approve active ticking. Uses the local phone clock.
